description: Related TikTok hashtags — Creative Center chart when it answers, otherwise a disclosed niche fallback. Flat 2 credits. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country for the Creative Center chart. Default US.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 20, max 100). Flat 2 credits per call.

newOnBoard.description: Only hashtags newly on the Top 100.

query.description: Optional niche seed for co-occurrence + challenge/detail enrich. Omit, or pass trending, to try the Creative Center chart (25s); a miss falls through to related tags for fyp (source=niche_fallback) and opens a service-wide chart circuit. Later default calls skip the chart (chartStatus=skipped_circuit_open) until the cooldown expires. Any other value skips the chart.

name: tiktok_popular_hashtags
